rongmei.title: Khat lev khat ta nzian mei hei jisu

lines: 1. Khat le khat ta nzian meihei jisu khang ,
Bang kariulou the niu ntam datlak khe,
Lum lou numei katan tan khang kaolou the.
Niu lung ning tang khin rikho kagan ta nkhuan kho.
Niu guai hei jisu khang zianmei
Lung ning guai , niu bang kariulou the
2. Aniu neila meilu khuan guai jisu khang .
Akhuan rui kata thuan suanchui ri rina ,
Aniu guai zauthai the kakhou lum loukhang .
Kaipou ruiguang pirun phung guang mak san
3. Mihei ai ningmei e ,jisu hei akhang.
Kazan khou along ning neila na bam ni,
Aniu gaimei ting kao namdai tang maksan ,
Zao lo him daimei guloumei purui, nkhuan bam .
